/- Exact finite-cylinder formulation of the target. This file contains definitions
   only. No theorem asserting SourceClaim has been proved. -/
namespace MathDB333569
noncomputable section
open Filter

def interior : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {z | 0 < z.1 ∧ z.1 < 1 ∧ 0 < z.2 ∧ z.2 < 1}

def trans (z : ℝ × ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  if a = 0 then (if b = 0 then z.1 else 1-z.1)
  else (if b = 0 then 1-z.2 else z.2)

def stationary (z : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  if a = 0 then (1-z.2)/(2-z.1-z.2) else (1-z.1)/(2-z.1-z.2)

def wordProb (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  stationary z (w 0) * ∏ i : Fin n, trans z (w i.castSucc) (w i.succ)

def marginal (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin (n+1)))
    (a : S → Fin 2) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2,
    if ∀ i : S, w i.val = a i then wordProb z n w else 0

def sampleEntropy (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin (n+1))) : ℝ :=
  - ∑ a : S → Fin 2, marginal z n S a * Real.log (marginal z n S a)

def finiteIntricacy (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact (2 * (∑ S : Finset (Fin (n+1)), sampleEntropy z n S) / (2:ℝ)^(n+1)
    - sampleEntropy z n Finset.univ) / (n+1:ℝ)

def sourceIntricacy (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (finiteIntricacy z)

def SourceClaim : Prop :=
  ∃ z ∈ interior, IsLocalMaxOn sourceIntricacy interior z ∧
    Tendsto (finiteIntricacy z) atTop (nhds (sourceIntricacy z))

end
end MathDB333569

/-- The eigenvalue/stationary-bias chart used in the ordinary proof. -/
def chart (l t : ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (1 - (1-l)*(1-t)/2, 1 - (1-l)*(1+t)/2)
def pi (t : ℝ) (a : Fin 2) : ℝ := if a = 0 then (1+t)/2 else (1-t)/2
def kernel (l t : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  l * (if a = b then 1 else 0) + (1-l) * pi t b

theorem chart_trans (l t : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    trans (chart l t) a b = kernel l t a b := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> norm_num [trans, chart, kernel, pi] <;> ring

theorem pi_sum (t : ℝ) : ∑ a : Fin 2, pi t a = 1 := by
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, pi]
  ring

theorem kernel_sum (l t : ℝ) (a : Fin 2) : ∑ b : Fin 2, kernel l t a b = 1 := by
  fin_cases a <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, kernel, pi] <;> ring

theorem pi_invariant (l t : ℝ) (b : Fin 2) :
    (∑ a : Fin 2, pi t a * kernel l t a b) = pi t b := by
  fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, kernel, pi] <;> ring

theorem kernel_comp (l r t : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    (∑ c : Fin 2, kernel l t a c * kernel r t c b) = kernel (l*r) t a b := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, kernel, pi] <;> ring

/-- Iterated transitions, including the zero-step identity. -/
def steps (l t : ℝ) : ℕ → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ
  | 0, a, b => if a = b then 1 else 0
  | n+1, a, b => ∑ c : Fin 2, steps l t n a c * kernel l t c b

theorem steps_eq (l t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    steps l t n a b = kernel (l^n) t a b := by
  induction n generalizing a b with
  | zero => simp [steps, kernel]
  | succ n ih => simp_rw [steps, ih, kernel_comp, pow_succ]

theorem chart_mem_interior {l t : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : -1 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) : chart l t ∈ interior := by
  have h₁ := mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1-l) (by linarith : 0 < 1-t)
  have h₂ := mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1-l) (by linarith : 0 < 1+t)
  have h₃ : (1-l)*(1-t) < 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hl (by linarith : 0 < 1-t)]
  have h₄ : (1-l)*(1+t) < 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hl (by linarith : 0 < 1+t)]
  change 0 < 1-(1-l)*(1-t)/2 ∧ _ ∧ _ ∧ _
  dsimp [chart]
  constructor; · linarith
  constructor; · linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem chart_stationary {l : ℝ} (hl : l ≠ 1) (t : ℝ) (a : Fin 2) :
    stationary (chart l t) a = pi t a := by
  have hd : 2-(chart l t).1-(chart l t).2 = 1-l := by dsimp [chart]; ring
  have hn : 1-l ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hl)
  fin_cases a <;> simp only [stationary, Fin.isValue, pi] <;>
    rw [hd] <;> dsimp [chart] <;> field_simp <;> ring

theorem kernel_pos {l t : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : -1 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (a b : Fin 2) : 0 < kernel l t a b := by
  have hp : 0 < pi t b := by fin_cases b <;> simp [pi] <;> linarith
  have hm : 0 < (1-l)*pi t b := mul_pos (by linarith) hp
  unfold kernel
  split_ifs <;> linarith

theorem stationary_pos {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (a : Fin 2) :
    0 < stationary z a := by
  rcases hz with ⟨hu, hu1, hv, hv1⟩
  have hd : 0 < 2-z.1-z.2 := by linarith
  fin_cases a <;> simp [stationary] <;> exact div_pos (by linarith) hd

theorem trans_pos {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (a b : Fin 2) :
    0 < trans z a b := by
  rcases hz with ⟨hu, hu1, hv, hv1⟩
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [trans] <;> linarith

theorem wordProb_pos {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ)
    (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) : 0 < wordProb z n w := by
  exact mul_pos (stationary_pos hz _) (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => trans_pos hz _ _)

/-- The inverse chart is algebraic; the nonzero denominator is an explicit domain fact. -/
theorem inverse_chart {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hd : 2-z.1-z.2 ≠ 0) :
    chart (z.1+z.2-1) ((z.1-z.2)/(2-z.1-z.2)) = z := by
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp [chart] <;> field_simp <;> ring

#print axioms chart_trans
#print axioms pi_invariant
#print axioms steps_eq
#print axioms chart_mem_interior
#print axioms chart_stationary
#print axioms wordProb_pos
#print axioms inverse_chart
end

open Set

def logOdds (r : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (1+r) - Real.log (1-r)
def transverseCoeff (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(1-r)/2 * logOdds r - (1-r)/(2*(1+r))
def coeffSlope (r : ℝ) : ℝ := logOdds r / 2 - r/(1+r)^2

theorem logOdds_eq {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (-1) 1) :
    logOdds r = Real.log ((1+r)/(1-r)) := by
  rw [Real.log_div (by linarith [hr.1] : 1+r ≠ 0) (by linarith [hr.2] : 1-r ≠ 0)]
  rfl

theorem logOdds_hasDerivAt {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (-1) 1) :
    HasDerivAt logOdds (2/((1-r)*(1+r))) r := by
  have ha : 1+r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.1]
  have hb : 1-r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.2]
  convert (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).log ha).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id r)).log hb) using 1 <;>
    first | rfl | (dsimp; field_simp; ring)

theorem coeffSlope_hasDerivAt {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (-1) 1) :
    HasDerivAt coeffSlope (4*r/((1-r)*(1+r)^3)) r := by
  have ha : 1+r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.1]
  have hb : 1-r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.2]
  convert ((logOdds_hasDerivAt hr).div_const 2).sub
    ((hasDerivAt_id r).div
      (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).pow 2)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 ha)) using 1 <;>
    first | rfl | (dsimp; field_simp; ring)

theorem transverseCoeff_hasDerivAt {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo (-1) 1) :
    HasDerivAt transverseCoeff (coeffSlope r) r := by
  have ha : 1+r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.1]
  have hb : 1-r ≠ 0 := by linarith [hr.2]
  convert (((((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id r)).neg).div_const 2).mul
    (logOdds_hasDerivAt hr)).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id r)).div
      (((hasDerivAt_const r (1:ℝ)).add (hasDerivAt_id r)).const_mul 2)
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha)) using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [coeffSlope]
    field_simp
    ring

theorem coeffSlope_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn coeffSlope (Ico 0 1) := by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ico 0 1)
  · intro r hr
    exact (coeffSlope_hasDerivAt ⟨by linarith [hr.1], hr.2⟩).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro r hr
    rw [interior_Ico] at hr
    rw [(coeffSlope_hasDerivAt ⟨by linarith [hr.1], hr.2⟩).deriv]
    exact div_pos (by linarith [hr.1])
      (mul_pos (by linarith [hr.2]) (pow_pos (by linarith [hr.1]) 3))

theorem coeffSlope_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Ioo 0 1) : 0 < coeffSlope r := by
  have h := coeffSlope_strictMonoOn (show (0:ℝ) ∈ Ico 0 1 by constructor <;> norm_num)
    ⟨le_of_lt hr.1, hr.2⟩ hr.1
  simpa [coeffSlope, logOdds] using h

theorem transverseCoeff_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn transverseCoeff (Ico 0 1) := by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ico 0 1)
  · intro r hr
    exact (transverseCoeff_hasDerivAt ⟨by linarith [hr.1], hr.2⟩).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro r hr
    rw [interior_Ico] at hr
    rw [(transverseCoeff_hasDerivAt ⟨by linarith [hr.1], hr.2⟩).deriv]
    exact coeffSlope_pos hr

theorem transverseCoeff_power_le {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Ioo 0 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    transverseCoeff (l^n) ≤ transverseCoeff l := by
  apply transverseCoeff_strictMonoOn.monotoneOn
    ⟨le_of_lt (pow_pos hl.1 n), pow_lt_one₀ (le_of_lt hl.1) hl.2 (by omega)⟩
    ⟨le_of_lt hl.1, hl.2⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [pow_add, pow_one]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (le_of_lt hl.1) (pow_le_one₀ (le_of_lt hl.1) (le_of_lt hl.2))

theorem transverseCoeff_square_lt {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Ioo 0 1) :
    transverseCoeff (l^2) < transverseCoeff l := by
  apply transverseCoeff_strictMonoOn
    ⟨le_of_lt (pow_pos hl.1 2), pow_lt_one₀ (le_of_lt hl.1) hl.2 (by omega)⟩
    ⟨le_of_lt hl.1, hl.2⟩
  nlinarith [mul_pos hl.1 (by linarith [hl.2] : 0 < 1-l)]

#print axioms transverseCoeff_hasDerivAt
#print axioms transverseCoeff_strictMonoOn
#print axioms transverseCoeff_power_le
#print axioms transverseCoeff_square_lt
end

namespace MathDB333569

theorem trans_sum (z : ℝ × ℝ) (a : Fin 2) : ∑ b : Fin 2, trans z a b = 1 := by
  fin_cases a <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, trans]

theorem stationary_sum {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) :
    (∑ a : Fin 2, stationary z a) = 1 := by
  have hd : 2-z.1-z.2 ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hz with ⟨_, hu, _, hv⟩
    linarith
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, stationary]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem stationary_invariant {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (b : Fin 2) :
    (∑ a : Fin 2, stationary z a * trans z a b) = stationary z b := by
  have hd : 2-z.1-z.2 ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hz with ⟨_, hu, _, hv⟩
    linarith
  fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, stationary, trans] <;> field_simp <;> ring

/-- One-step extension of a consecutive cylinder at its right endpoint. -/
theorem wordProb_snoc (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) (b : Fin 2) :
    wordProb z (n+1) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (n+2) => Fin 2) w b) = wordProb z n w * trans z (w (Fin.last n)) b := by
  unfold wordProb
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  have h0 : Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (n+2) => Fin 2) w b 0 = w 0 := by
    simp
  rw [h0]
  simp only [Fin.succ_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
  have hh : (∏ i : Fin n, trans z (w i.castSucc) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (n+2) => Fin 2) w b i.castSucc.succ)) =
      ∏ i : Fin n, trans z (w i.castSucc) (w i.succ) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [show i.castSucc.succ = i.succ.castSucc from rfl, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  rw [hh]
  ring

theorem wordProb_right_consistent (z : ℝ × ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) :
    (∑ b : Fin 2, wordProb z (n+1) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (n+2) => Fin 2) w b)) = wordProb z n w := by
  simp_rw [wordProb_snoc]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, trans_sum, mul_one]

/-- Split a finite word into its prefix and its last symbol. -/
def snocEquiv (n : ℕ) : ((Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) × Fin 2) ≃ (Fin (n+2) → Fin 2) where
  toFun v := Fin.snoc v.1 v.2
  invFun w := (fun i => w i.castSucc, w (Fin.last (n+1)))
  left_inv v := by simp
  right_inv w := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp

def oneWordEquiv : Fin 2 ≃ (Fin 1 → Fin 2) where
  toFun a := fun _ => a
  invFun w := w 0
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv w := by funext i; fin_cases i; rfl

/-- Finite consecutive-cylinder weights really are normalized distributions. -/
theorem wordProb_sum {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2, wordProb z n w) = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv oneWordEquiv
      (fun a => stationary z a) (wordProb z 0) (by intro a; simp [oneWordEquiv, wordProb])]
    exact stationary_sum hz
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv (snocEquiv n)
      (fun v => wordProb z (n+1) (Fin.snoc v.1 v.2)) (wordProb z (n+1)) (by intro v; rfl)]
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [wordProb_right_consistent]
    exact ih

theorem marginal_nonneg {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n+1))) (a : S → Fin 2) : 0 ≤ marginal z n S a := by
  classical
  unfold marginal
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro w _
  split_ifs
  · exact le_of_lt (wordProb_pos hz n w)
  · exact le_rfl

theorem marginal_sum {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n+1))) : (∑ a : S → Fin 2, marginal z n S a) = 1 := by
  classical
  have he (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2) (a : S → Fin 2) :
      (∀ i : S, w i.val = a i) ↔ a = (fun i : S => w i.val) := by
    constructor
    · intro h; funext i; exact (h i).symm
    · intro h; subst a; intro i; rfl
  unfold marginal
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simpa using wordProb_sum hz n

theorem marginal_pos {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ)
    (S : Finset (Fin (n+1))) (a : S → Fin 2) : 0 < marginal z n S a := by
  classical
  let w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2 := fun i => if hi : i ∈ S then a ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
  have hw : ∀ i : S, w i.val = a i := by intro i; simp [w, i.property]
  have hle : wordProb z n w ≤ marginal z n S a := by
    unfold marginal
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun v : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2 => if ∀ i : S, v i.val = a i then wordProb z n v else 0)
      (s := Finset.univ) (a := w)
      (by intro v _; split_ifs; exact le_of_lt (wordProb_pos hz n v); exact le_rfl)
      (Finset.mem_univ w)
    simpa [hw] using hh
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (wordProb_pos hz n w) hle

theorem marginal_empty {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ)
    (a : (∅ : Finset (Fin (n+1))) → Fin 2) : marginal z n ∅ a = 1 := by
  classical
  unfold marginal
  simpa using wordProb_sum hz n

theorem sampleEntropy_empty {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ∈ interior) (n : ℕ) :
    sampleEntropy z n ∅ = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold sampleEntropy
  simp_rw [marginal_empty hz n, Real.log_one, mul_zero]
  simp

#print axioms marginal_pos
#print axioms marginal_empty
#print axioms sampleEntropy_empty
#print axioms marginal_nonneg
#print axioms marginal_sum
#print axioms wordProb_sum
#print axioms stationary_sum
#print axioms stationary_invariant
#print axioms wordProb_snoc
#print axioms wordProb_right_consistent
end

namespace MathDB333569

open Set

def gapEntropy (r : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.binEntropy ((1-r)/2)
def diagonalTerm (l : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1/2:ℝ)^(n+1) * (gapEntropy (l^(n+1)) - gapEntropy l)
def diagonal (l : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, diagonalTerm l n

theorem pow_le_base {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Icc 0 1) (n : ℕ) : l^(n+1) ≤ l := by
  rw [pow_succ]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hl.1 (pow_le_one₀ hl.1 hl.2)

theorem gapEntropy_nonneg {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Icc 0 1) : 0 ≤ gapEntropy l := by
  apply Real.binEntropy_nonneg <;> linarith [hl.1, hl.2]

theorem gapEntropy_le (l : ℝ) : gapEntropy l ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.binEntropy_le_log_two

theorem gapEntropy_anti : AntitoneOn gapEntropy (Icc 0 1) := by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  apply Real.binEntropy_strictMonoOn.monotoneOn
  · constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]
  · constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  · linarith

theorem diagonalTerm_nonneg {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Icc 0 1) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ diagonalTerm l n := by
  apply mul_nonneg (by positivity)
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (gapEntropy_anti
    ⟨pow_nonneg hl.1 _, pow_le_one₀ hl.1 hl.2⟩ hl (pow_le_base hl n))

theorem diagonalTerm_bound {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Icc 0 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖diagonalTerm l n‖ ≤ (1/2:ℝ)^(n+1) * Real.log 2 := by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (diagonalTerm_nonneg hl n)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (by linarith [gapEntropy_le (l^(n+1)), gapEntropy_nonneg hl]) (by positivity)

theorem geometricMajorant_summable :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1/2:ℝ)^(n+1) * Real.log 2) := by
  have h : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1/2:ℝ)^n) := summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num)
  simpa only [pow_succ, mul_assoc] using (h.mul_right (1/2)).mul_right (Real.log 2)

theorem diagonal_summable {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Icc 0 1) : Summable (diagonalTerm l) :=
  geometricMajorant_summable.of_norm_bounded (diagonalTerm_bound hl)

theorem diagonal_continuousOn : ContinuousOn diagonal (Icc 0 1) := by
  apply continuousOn_tsum (u := fun n : ℕ => (1/2:ℝ)^(n+1)*Real.log 2)
  · intro n
    unfold diagonalTerm gapEntropy
    fun_prop
  · exact geometricMajorant_summable
  · intro n l hl
    exact diagonalTerm_bound hl n

theorem diagonal_zero : diagonal 0 = 0 := by
  simp [diagonal, diagonalTerm]
theorem diagonal_one : diagonal 1 = 0 := by
  simp [diagonal, diagonalTerm]

theorem diagonal_pos {l : ℝ} (hl : l ∈ Ioo 0 1) : 0 < diagonal l := by
  apply (diagonal_summable ⟨le_of_lt hl.1, le_of_lt hl.2⟩).tsum_pos
    (diagonalTerm_nonneg ⟨le_of_lt hl.1, le_of_lt hl.2⟩) 1
  apply mul_pos (by positivity)
  apply sub_pos.mpr

def OneStepMarkovLaw (μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace) : Prop :=
  ∃ (z : ℝ × ℝ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ),
    (0 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) ∧ (∑ a, p a = 1) ∧
    (∀ b, ∑ a, p a * trans z a b = p b) ∧
    ∀ (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2),
      (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) {x | ∀ j : Fin (n+1), x (k+j.val) = w j} =
        ENNReal.ofReal (p (w 0) * ∏ j : Fin n, trans z (w j.castSucc) (w j.succ))

def lawMass (μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace) (E : Set ShiftSpace) : ℝ := (μ E : ℝ)
def stateCylinder (a : Fin 2) : Set ShiftSpace := {x | x 0 = a}
def diagonalCylinder (a : Fin 2) : Set ShiftSpace := {x | x 0 = a ∧ x 1 = a}
def recoveredTransitions (μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace) : ℝ × ℝ :=
  (lawMass μ (diagonalCylinder 0)/lawMass μ (stateCylinder 0),
   lawMass μ (diagonalCylinder 1)/lawMass μ (stateCylinder 1))

def bundledLaw (z : ℝ × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ interior) : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace :=
  ⟨twoSidedLaw z hz,inferInstance⟩

def actualIntricacy (μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace) : ℝ :=
  Filter.limUnder atTop (rankZeroFiniteIntricacy (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) 0)

theorem stateCylinder_isClopen (a : Fin 2) : IsClopen (stateCylinder a) := by
  exact (isClopen_discrete ({a} : Set (Fin 2))).preimage (continuous_apply 0)

theorem diagonalCylinder_isClopen (a : Fin 2) : IsClopen (diagonalCylinder a) := by
  exact (stateCylinder_isClopen a).inter
    ((isClopen_discrete ({a} : Set (Fin 2))).preimage (continuous_apply 1))

theorem lawMass_continuous {E : Set ShiftSpace} (hE : IsClopen E) :
    Continuous (fun μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace => lawMass μ E) := by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro μ
  exact NNReal.continuous_coe.continuousAt.comp
    (ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_measure_of_isClopen_of_tendsto continuous_id.continuousAt hE)

theorem stationary_unique {z : ℝ × ℝ} {p : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hs : ∑ a, p a = 1) (hp : ∀ b, ∑ a, p a * trans z a b = p b)
    (hd : 2-z.1-z.2 ≠ 0) : p = stationary z := by
  have h0 := hp 0
  norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two,trans] at h0
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hs
  have he : p 1 = 1-p 0 := by linarith
  rw [he] at h0
  funext a
  fin_cases a
  · change p 0 = (1-z.2)/(2-z.1-z.2)
    apply (eq_div_iff hd).mpr
    nlinarith
  · change p 1 = (1-z.1)/(2-z.1-z.2)
    apply (eq_div_iff hd).mpr
    rw [he]
    nlinarith


theorem lawMass_initial {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace} {z : ℝ × ℝ} {p : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hblock : ∀ (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2),
      (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) {x | ∀ j : Fin (n+1), x (k+j.val) = w j} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (p (w 0)*∏ j : Fin n, trans z (w j.castSucc) (w j.succ)))
    (a : Fin 2) : lawMass μ (stateCylinder a) = p a := by
  have he : stateCylinder a = {x : ShiftSpace | ∀ j : Fin 1, x ((0:ℤ)+j.val) = a} := by
    ext x; simp [stateCylinder]
  change ((μ : Measure ShiftSpace) (stateCylinder a)).toReal = _
  rw [he,hblock]
  simp [hp]

theorem lawMass_diagonal {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace} {z : ℝ × ℝ} {p : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hz : 0 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 1)
    (hblock : ∀ (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (w : Fin (n+1) → Fin 2),
      (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) {x | ∀ j : Fin (n+1), x (k+j.val) = w j} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (p (w 0)*∏ j : Fin n, trans z (w j.castSucc) (w j.succ)))
    (a : Fin 2) : lawMass μ (diagonalCylinder a) = p a * trans z a a := by
  have he : diagonalCylinder a = {x : ShiftSpace | ∀ j : Fin 2, x ((0:ℤ)+j.val) = a} := by

  have hK : 0 ≤ trans z a a := by

    · simpa [trans] using hz.1
    · simpa [trans] using hz.2.2.1
  change ((μ : Measure ShiftSpace) (diagonalCylinder a)).toReal = _

  simp [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (mul_nonneg (hp a) hK)]

theorem recoveredTransitions_eq {μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace} {z : ℝ × ℝ} {p : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hz : 0 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ z.2 ∧ z.2 ≤ 1)

    recoveredTransitions μ = z := by
  unfold recoveredTransitions
  simp_rw [lawMass_initial (fun a => (hp a).le) hblock,
    lawMass_diagonal (fun a => (hp a).le) hz hblock]
  apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> norm_num [trans] <;> field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp 0),ne_of_gt (hp 1)]

    recoveredTransitions (bundledLaw z hz) = z :=
  recoveredTransitions_eq (stationary_pos hz) ⟨hz.1.le,hz.2.1.le,hz.2.2.1.le,hz.2.2.2.le⟩
    (bundledLaw_block z hz)

    (h0 : lawMass μ (stateCylinder 0) ≠ 0) (h1 : lawMass μ (stateCylinder 1) ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt recoveredTransitions μ := by

    (lawMass_continuous (stateCylinder_isClopen 0)).continuousAt h0).prodMk
    ((lawMass_continuous (diagonalCylinder_isClopen 1)).continuousAt.div
      (lawMass_continuous (stateCylinder_isClopen 1)).continuousAt h1)

    OneStepMarkovLaw (bundledLaw z hz) :=

    · rwa [lawMass_initial hp hblock] at h1

  change (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) = twoSidedLaw (recoveredTransitions μ) hz

    change (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) _ = twoSidedLaw (recoveredTransitions μ) hz _
    rw [hblock,twoSidedLaw_word]
    simp only [wordProb,hpstat,hrec]

theorem markov_neighborhood_convergence {l : ℝ} (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) :
    ∀ᶠ ν in nhds (bundledLaw (chart l 0) (chart_mem_interior hl hl1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num))),

  let z := chart l 0
  have hz : z ∈ interior := chart_mem_interior hl hl1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  let μ := bundledLaw z hz
  have hm (a : Fin 2) : lawMass μ (stateCylinder a) = stationary z a :=

  have h0 : 0 < lawMass μ (stateCylinder 0) := by rw [hm]; exact stationary_pos hz 0
  have h1 : 0 < lawMass μ (stateCylinder 1) := by rw [hm]; exact stationary_pos hz 1
  have hrec : recoveredTransitions μ = z := bundledLaw_recovered z hz
  have hc := recoveredTransitions_continuousAt (ne_of_gt h0) (ne_of_gt h1)

    apply hcD.eventually_ne

  have hN1 := (lawMass_continuous (stateCylinder_isClopen 1)).continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h1)

    rw [hEq]

theorem fullySupported_stationary_oneStep_localMaximum :
    ∃ μ : ProbabilityMeasure ShiftSpace,

    exact eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hmax
  have hmaxnear := hc.eventually (hrec ▸ hevent)
  have hconvactual : Tendsto (rankZeroFiniteIntricacy (μ : Measure ShiftSpace) 0) atTop

    change Tendsto (rankZeroFiniteIntricacy (twoSidedLaw z hz) 0) atTop
